meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解书面计划、并行推进执行,并为每个步骤留下证据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一份写好的计划,想让多个自动化帮手照章执行、边做边向你交代进度。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written plan into tracked parallel agent execution.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a concrete plan and want helpers to run it in parallel with clear progress logs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 不会自己写代码或改文件。它会读工作计划，把待办拆小、分给多个子代理并行执行，再核对结果并更新进度记录，直到计划项全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-execute”、“start work”或要求运行 `.omo/plans` 里的某个计划时触发；若还没有可选计划，它会先引导生成一份再执行。

say.text: 执行 `.omo/plans` 里的 `web-redesign` 计划。
say.note: Claude 会选中该计划并逐项推进所有待办。

say.text: 运行 ulw-execute，接着上次的进度继续。
say.note: 它会恢复记录中的未完成任务并派发子代理。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute --ship 完成整个计划并合入。
say.note: 它会在 PR 打开后持续跟进，直到合并才收尾。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator that never implements: it reads a plan, breaks each todo into units, delegates them to parallel subagents, checks the outcomes, and tracks progress until every item is complete.
howto.when_en: It activates when you say “ulw-execute” or “start work”, or when you ask it to run an existing plan under `.omo/plans`. In the absence of a plan, it bootstraps one before executing.

say_en.note: It selects that plan and advances through its pending items.

say_en.text: Run ulw-execute and continue from the saved progress.
say_en.note: It restores the unfinished work and dispatches subagents.

say_en.text: Use ulw-execute --ship to deliver and merge the whole plan.
say_en.note: It keeps tracking until the PR merges, then cleans up.
